conclusion.text: GRÜNER EIENDOM AS is an active private limited company in real estate activities, based in Oslo. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 2 083 714 and a profit of NOK 1 378 427, with positive equity of NOK 11 780 737. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 12 931 084 and net income was NOK 5 257 964. CEO: Kenneth Kjelland Braathen; board chair: Kenneth Kjelland Braathen; auditor: HVERVEN REVISJON AS. Most recent dated item found (2026-08-05): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.
